maya_ml: quick brain dump — proposing a small refactor to kernel selection that routes long-seqlen requests to a "slowpath" kernel earlier, plus an autotuned KV cache keying change so we don't thrash on model-reloads. thoughts?

kevin_r: TL;DR? is this about perf regressions we saw last week with gpt-like long contexts?

maya_ml: yes. the regression looks like: when sequence_len > 2048 we keep using the short-seq optimized matmul kernel which ends up slower due to repeated kernel-switching and KV cache misses. also driver/model rollouts cause invalidation storms because cache keys include runtime instance ids.

ana: can you sketch the routing rules? is it just a static cutoff or dynamic?

maya_ml: plan A (simple): static thresholds per-arch determined from profiling (e.g., A100: cutoff=2048, H100: 3072). Plan B (autotune): at startup we run a micro-benchmark on representative seqlens and pick kernels, then store picks in a lightweight persisted cache.

jonah_infra: micro-bench at startup sounds doable but we need guardrails — startup time + variability across instance types. what persists? model->arch->seqlen->kernel mapping?

maya_ml: exact idea: key = "kernelpick:v1:{model_hash}:{arch_label}:{seq_bucket}" where seq_bucket is one of {<=512,512-2048,2048-4096,>4096}. value = kernel_name + measured_latency_p50. Persist in KV store (etcd) with TTL 7d, and update asynchronously if subsequent requests contradict picks.

kevin_r: we should not include ephemeral driver ids in the key. that caused the invalidation storms. but we might need to version picks when runtime ABI changes. how detect ABI change?

maya_ml: runtime ABI/version and model config hash should be part of the key. not instance ids. validation: on deploy, deploy-bot can increment a rollout-version tag; picks with older rollout-version are treated as stale.

deploy-bot: note: we already tag deployments with rollout_version in /deploy metadata. I can expose a webhook so runtime picks can subscribe and invalidate keys on major rollouts. :white_check_mark:

ana: invalidate policy: keep soft-invalidated picks for 1h (fall back to auto-microbenchmark) and hard-delete after 7d? we might lose warm-start benefits if prod churns a lot.

jonah_infra: agreed. Also need concurrency control: if multiple nodes try to micro-bench and write the same key, we should use lease-based leader election or CAS. etcd supports compare-and-swap, we can use that.

maya_ml: sample pseudocode for write (CAS):
```
existing = etcd.get(key)
if not existing or existing.version < my_result.version:
  etcd.txn(if version==existing.version then put(key,my_result) else fail)
```

kevin_r: caching semantics around KV cache: proposal to separate KV cache keyspace from kernel pick keyspace. KV cache keys remain session/model-specific and include evictable flags. kernel picks are global per model+arch+bucket. don't conflate.

maya_ml: yes. the current bug was using a combined key that included runtime_node_id; that made every new node create fresh kernel picks and also evict the KV store due to name collisions.

jonah_infra: ops question: how do we invalidate KV when a model is hot-swapped? we should keep a model-instance->cache-manifest so we can targeted-invalidate rather than global flush.

kevin_r: implement cache manifests: small bloom filter or list of keys per model-instance with a TTL. on model unload we call KV_DELETE(manifest_keys) async. avoids full driver flush.

maya_ml: perf-bot — can you run a multi-arch sim for seqlen 1024/4096 with current kernel routing vs proposed routing + persisted picks?

perf-bot: queued perf job 1770004330. will post metrics into #perf-logs when done. ETA ~20m.

ana: also add telemetry flags: increments for fallbacks triggered from picks, and histogram of micro-benchmark runtimes so we can detect noisy neighbors.

jonah_infra: one more thought: when model quantization changes (int8->fp16) kernel choice might change. ensure model_config_hash captures quantization metadata.

maya_ml: yep included in model_hash. next steps: implement seed micro-benchmark + etcd persisted mapping (v1), change key schema to remove instance ids, add deploy webhook for rollout_version invalidation, and implement manifest-based KV invalidation. i'll draft a PR and do a short design doc.

kevin_r: sounds good. please include a migration plan: backfill picks for hot models from perf logs before flip.

maya_ml: will do. thanks all :rocket:
